horoscope: There can be some reason to hesitate or need to make adjustments at times today, dear Aries, possibly related to your resources or even the perception of your value and worth in a situation. Self-doubt or confusion is temporary, but when it's in the forefront, it's wise to avoid impulsive moves. Building emotional strength and self-esteem are in order with the Moon's transit of your solar fourth house in the first half of the day. Quiet or behind-the-scenes activities seem to fare best. As the day advances, you pay more attention to the things you love, as well as games, entertainment, and activities that allow you to express yourself and your sense of fun. A relationship can expand as you share your ideas or personal interests.

There can be times today when you experience a brief spell of feeling undervalued or unmotivated, dear Taurus. However, it may get you closer to yourself as you explore the reasons. The second half of the day finds you rather introspective, with the Moon's move into your solar fourth house, but in no way unfriendly. While it's not a time for pushing or reaching beyond boundaries, you're in great shape to emotionally prepare for more demanding days. Strive for a sense of being grounded, rooted, and secure today for best results, but stay open to new ways of getting comfortable. It can feel good to face a reality–even empowering. You might figure out how to make better use of your leisure time and cut out those things that interfere with getting the most out of your downtime.

Things left undone or hanging may bother you at times today, dear Gemini, but this can be instructive and help you understand your buried insecurities better. As the day advances, the Moon moves into your communications sector, stirring a desire to communicate, connect, and collect information. It connects harmoniously with Uranus in your sign, and others receive you well. They're inclined to see the maverick or unique side of you right now. Still, the day also holds good energy for thinking seriously about home and family matters, as well as for solving practical problems in your life in a general sense. You're keeping in mind your long-term goals and priorities as you go about your day.

Insecurities or matters that are left hanging can sometimes surface today, dear Cancer, but choosing to see differences with people as engaging and interesting rather than annoying can be helpful. It’s easier to focus on what’s working in your life as the day advances. Practical matters thrive with your powerful intuition. Logic and emotions mix quite beautifully, making it an excellent time to put what you have to better use. With the Moon's move out of your sign and into your solar second house, you're more inclined to stick with the familiar than to venture out looking for new experiences, and emotions are easier to tuck away. You might successfully turn recent ideas into practical, real terms and forms. You’re craving more organization, structure, and predictability.

While you may need a little time to collect yourself at times today, dear Leo, slowing down and a small level of hesitation can help you find yourself, in fact. Letting go of tensions can come easily as the day advances. The Moon heads into your sign, and you’ll find it easier than usual to express yourself. This is certainly a time in the lunar month for self-nurturing, but there are also good channels for expressing your emotions through sharing. In the first half of the day, ease into things, as it's best to rest and regroup, from which time you crave more connection. Feelings that you've set aside or buried to deal with other issues in your life can rush up to the surface now. You'll need to deal with the expectations of people important to you eventually, but you also need some personal space!

A brief dip in your faith about a matter is possible today, dear Virgo, making it better to let things unfold rather than make sudden or bold moves just for now, with current aspects in play. Your mind may be busy in the first half of the day, and you may feel engaged and connected. In the second half of the day, the Moon transits your privacy sector, drawing your attention to behind-the-scenes, background, and private matters. It's a time in the lunar month to take some of the pressure off your life to regroup. While the desire to escape or retreat from the usual noise and activity of life is real, routine can be dissatisfying as well now, and a change of scenery may be just right.

You could experience some feelings of discomfort related to your more profound emotions, attractions, and attachments today, dear Libra. Do your best to keep this from chipping away at your mood. Consider it a signal to give your heart a little more time on a matter. You might crave some recreation or inspiration as the day advances, while the first half of the day is stronger for taking care of business. Doing favors for others may be a good way to express yourself, and you can feel especially enthusiastic about a topic. This is also a time to think seriously about the past or reassess recent events. Strategizing and focusing on good ideas and plans can be successful.

You can be blissfully unfocused in the first half of the day, dear Scorpio, after which the Moon heads to your solar tenth house, putting you in a more serious frame of mind. Today's Mercury-Saturn parallel similarly gives you pause to think. You could be carefully considering a friendship or group association, assessing it in practical terms. Alternatively, you may be seeing the reality of a certain path you're taking and recognizing the need to adjust your plans. Responsibilities to others can make themselves known. Solid, helpful wisdom may be coming your way now, but do take moments to loosen up if you start to feel wound up. It's a good time to get back on track. You can accomplish a great deal on practical levels.

Insecurities or uncertainties can bother you at times today, dear Sagittarius, disrupting your routines or mood. However, these things can help you build emotional strength. As the day advances, you're interested in getting out and about or more actively involved in life, as a participant rather than an observer, with the Moon's move into your solar ninth house. If you can take a detour from the routine, your mood tends to elevate. You take a stronger interest in new ideas, places, and people. Still, there can be a call to duty of sorts, as responsibilities become more apparent, and there seems to be a stronger need for organization, realism, and discipline.

You may experience some hesitation when it comes to expressing yourself openly and naturally at times today, dear Capricorn. However, this insecurity can be quite instructive. Be open to learning about yourself and what makes you feel vulnerable. Putting a new spin on things can change everything, in a good way! The Moon continues its transit of your partnership sector in the first half of the day, and bringing more harmony and a stronger sense of balance to your life is in focus. In the second half of the day, you're a little more serious-minded, or you simply want something to grab your attention. You're looking to feel a little more powerful and in control of impulses that aren't serving you well. You can benefit from taking a step back and planning your next move. You want to face reality and realign your thinking and your plans accordingly.

While there can be a minor confidence dip in spots today, dear Aquarius, it's a strong day for practical thinking that benefits you. As the day advances, you become more and more focused on relationships. You're adaptable and accommodating, and you have a way of expressing yourself that draws people in. You might also be weighing pros and cons, or adjusting areas of your life that have fallen out of balance. You may be in the position to strike a compromise. It can also be a time to consider attitudes that may need changing to go after what you want and need more effectively. It’s a good time for finding ways to improve your finances by cutting back.

Some introspection can do you some good today, dear Pisces. Today’s thinking is unusually clear and realistic, although there can be moments when insecurities are a little more prominent. Serious thoughts about relationships can run high, or conversations with a significant other can take on a heavy or practical tone. Practical concerns in a relationship tend to take higher priority with today’s energies, or you may be getting serious about a project that involves joint decision-making. As the day advances, you prefer not to be idle, and you're ready to put in the work. The Moon brings added emotional charge to the details and flaws, making it a strong time for fixing problems, unless you end up fixating on problems instead of trying to solve them, which could lead to a lot of unnecessary stress.
